briefings.title: John Cornyn Celebrates Efforts To Strengthen Critical Mineral Supply Chain, Reshore Chip Industry
briefings.tldr: Sen. John Cornyn (R-TX) highlights the urgent national security and economic risks of America's reliance on foreign nations—particularly China and Taiwan—for advanced semiconductors and critical minerals, championing the bipartisan CHIPS and Science Act as a crucial legislative success to reshore manufacturing and secure US leadership in the global AI race.
